title: Rental Rates for Hawker Stalls at Centres Managed by NEA and Social Enterprises
what_it_is: Rental Rates for Hawker Stalls at Centres Managed by NEA and Social Enterprises

sections.label: New hawker centre stall rentals
sections.summary: Stall rentals at seven new hawker centres range from $750 to $3,700 monthly, in line with comparable existing centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The stall rentals at the seven new hawker centres managed by the Socially-conscious Enterprises range from $750 to $3,700 a month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: This is in line with the median rental of stalls in comparable existing hawker centres at $1,700 per month, after accounting for the larger stall size, better-designed stalls and amenities at the new centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The rentals of non-subsidised stalls at comparable existing centres range from $640 to $3,900 a month.

sections.label: S&CC and table-cleaning fees
sections.summary: S&CC and table-cleaning fees at new centres fall within the ranges at existing centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For example, the S&CC at the new centres are between $110 and $350 a month, which are within the range of $130 to $450 a month at our existing centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Table-cleaning fees at the new centres are between $300 and $550 a month, which are also within the range of $200 to $830 a month at our existing centres.

sections.label: Productive Hawker Centre grants extension
sections.summary: Productive Hawker Centre grants are extended, giving stallholders 50% CDW cost reduction in year one and 30% in year two.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To help the hawkers in new centres better manage costs, we are extending the Productive Hawker Centre grants to them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: From 1 January this year, the stallholders will see a 50% reduction in their CDW costs for the first year and 30% for the second year.
